jobs.title: Senior ERP Consultant – Implementation & Customer Success - Field / Remote UK
jobs.description:
Implement. Improve. Challenge. Make ERP Actually Work for the Customer.

Great ERP consultants don’t just implement software – they transform how businesses work.

This is a role for an experienced ERP consultant who wants more than project delivery. You’ll stay close to the customer, own the outcome and help businesses get genuine, lasting value from their ERP system.

You’ll combine commercial insight, technical expertise and hands-on problem-solving across the entire customer journey – from discovery and implementation to go-live, optimisation and ongoing success.

Ready to own the outcome
, challenge the status quo and make ERP genuinely work for the customer? Read on
.

The Role at a Glance

Senior ERP Consultant
UK Field-Based | Extensive UK Travel & Regular Overnight Stays
£55,000 – £65,000 + Car Allowance + Benefits
Permanent | Full Time

Your Expertise:
ERP Implementation, Customer Success, Business Process Mapping, SQL, Change & Optimisation, Training, Data and Operational Systems

The Opportunity

We build ERP software that helps ambitious UK businesses run their day-to-day operations – from orders, stock, purchasing and warehouse processes to fulfilment, reporting, finance and customer service.

Customers don’t just need software configured. They need someone who can understand how their business works, guide them through change and make sure the system genuinely improves how they operate.

As a Senior ERP Consultant, you’ll work directly with both new and established customers. You’ll deliver implementations, improve existing setups, educate users, solve operational problems and make sure customers see the value of the system.

You’ll be the trusted expert on the ground – running discovery sessions, mapping business processes, challenging assumptions, configuring practical solutions, supporting go-lives and helping users build confidence.

This is a small, agile and fast-moving software business, so this isn’t a narrow “caretaker” role.

You’ll get involved beyond the traditional boundaries of implementation, helping shape how projects are delivered, how the product develops and how customers are supported.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Delivering ERP implementation projects across different industries.
• Leading optimisation, improvement and change projects within existing customer environments.
• Understanding customer workflows and translating them into practical ERP solutions.
• Running discovery, requirements gathering, process mapping, training and go-live support.
• Configuring solutions and supporting customers through implementation and adoption.
• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and day-to-day users.
• Challenging customer assumptions constructively when there’s a better way to achieve the outcome.
• Using SQL and data investigation to support configuration, troubleshooting and validation.
• Working closely with Support, Product and Development to resolve issues and improve delivery.
• Feeding customer insight back into the business to improve the product, process and customer experience.
• Helping shape how implementation and Customer Success are delivered as the business grows.

About You

This isn’t a role for someone who has simply administered an ERP platform internally. You’ll be an experienced ERP consultant who understands implementation, operational processes and what it takes to guide customers successfully through change.

You’ll bring:

• At least five years’ experience implementing, consulting on or advising around ERP systems.
• Proven experience delivering successful ERP implementations and strong customer outcomes.
• Experience improving, optimising or leading change within existing ERP customer environments.
• Strong knowledge of processes such as stock, purchasing, order management, fulfilment, finance and reporting.
• Solid SQL and technical capability, with the confidence to investigate data and get under the hood when required.
• Experience running discovery, requirements gathering and business process mapping.
• Confidence training users and working with non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge, guide and influence.
• The ability to bring structure and calm when customers are under pressure.
• A practical, proactive mindset and willingness to get involved wherever the customer or wider business needs you.
• The flexibility to travel extensively across the UK and stay away from home regularly.

What This Role Isn’t

This isn’t a desk-only ERP configuration role.

You won’t spend your working life sitting remotely and configuring tickets somebody else has scoped.

You’ll work with real businesses, real operational pressure and sometimes messy problems. You’ll need the technical confidence to investigate issues properly, alongside the commercial judgement to understand what the customer is really trying to achieve.

Equally, this isn’t purely a new implementation role. A significant part of your value will come from returning to established customers, identifying where they could be getting more from their ERP environment and leading the improvements needed to make that happen.

The Travel

This is a genuinely field-based, customer-facing position.

You’ll travel extensively across the UK to work directly with customers, including regular overnight stays away from home.

If you enjoy getting out from behind the screen, understanding customer operations first-hand and becoming their trusted ERP expert, it could be exactly what you’re looking for.

Why Join?

• £55,000 – £65,000 salary.
• Car allowance plus additional company benefits.
• Genuine ownership of customer outcomes.
• Variety across implementations, optimisation and operational problem-solving.
• Direct access to leadership within a small, agile business.
• The opportunity to influence project delivery, product development and Customer Success.
• A role where your commercial, operational and technical expertise are equally valued.
• The chance to see the real-world impact of the solutions you deliver.

Your Experience May Include
Senior ERP Consultant, ERP Implementation Consultant, ERP Software Consultant, ERP Functional Consultant, Business Systems Consultant, Implementation Consultant, ERP Application Consultant, ERP Customer Success Consultant or Senior Software Consultant.

Ready to Own the Outcome?

If you enjoy getting close to customers, understanding how their businesses really operate and turning ERP technology into measurable improvements, we’d love to meet you.

Bring your ERP expertise
, SQL capability, commercial judgement and willingness to get out there with customers – and help make sure powerful software delivers powerful results.

Application notice... We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

Good luck, Team RR.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

Cologne

Become the trusted partner for production companies across Germany.

Our client is a leading provider of production management software trusted by the world's top entertainment companies, serving broadcasters and production companies managing budgets from £2M to £100M+.
They are now scaling their customer success function in the German market. They need a hands-on CSM who can drive client adoption, ensure retention, and identify expansion opportunities

The Opportunity

You will own the complete customer lifecycle for German-speaking entertainment companies. Not a salesperson, a trusted advisor who ensures every client extracts maximum value from their platform.
You will design and execute implementation plans that set clients up for success from day one. You will manage timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment. You will conduct comprehensive training sessions, create learning materials, and ensure users adopt core workflows and maximize value from the platform.
You will build deep relationships with key stakeholders. You will conduct quarterly business reviews, understand their goals, and ensure the platform delivers measurable ROI. You will identify opportunities for clients to expand usage, add modules, or increase adoption. You will surface customer pain points, feature requests, and workflow gaps, and be the advocate for customers inside the organisation.
You will manage a portfolio of 10-20 clients in different lifecycle stages. You will prioritise where you add most value and stay organised and proactive across a diverse portfolio. This is hands-on work. You will troubleshoot issues, solve real problems, and become the trusted point of contact clients rely on.

The Person

3+ years in SaaS customer success or customer onboarding roles.
You have built implementation plans, trained clients on software, managed adoption metrics, and measured retention. You understand CSM methodology and best practices.
Fluent in German, proficient in English.
You communicate clearly in both languages with clients and their international team.
Implementation & Onboarding expertise.
You have run successful software implementations. You know how to scope work, manage timelines, train users on complex systems, and measure adoption success.
Client-focused mindset.
You are invested in whether clients succeed. You build trust and become a valued partner. You measure success by client ROI and retention, not pipeline.
Organised and systematic.
You can manage multiple clients in different phases. You prioritise what matters. You use data to track adoption metrics and client health. You think in milestones and dependencies.
Technical comfort.
You are comfortable learning complex software quickly. You can work with product and implementation teams. You understand how enterprise systems work. You can troubleshoot issues and explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

What You Get

Remote role based in Germany (Cologne or Berlin preferred).
A small, dynamic company (30 people) building something real. Your work directly impacts how they grow and how clients succeed.
Structured onboarding. 2-3 months of training and mentoring. You will learn the product, the market, and be ready to run independently.
Working with a product that solves real problems. Production companies have spent years juggling spreadsheets and fragmented systems. This company is their solution.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Customer Service, Project Management, and Information Technology

Industries

Software Development, IT Services and IT Consulting, and Technology, Information and Media
